feedback.problem: What linear transformation $T$ is represented by the matrix $T=[\begin{aligned}17 & 0 \\ 0 & 17\end{aligned}]?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Recall that a dilation of scale factor $k$ is represented by the matrix

$$
[\begin{aligned}k & 0 \\ 0 & k\end{aligned}].
$$

Here, we have $k=17.$ Therefore, the matrix represents a dilation with a scale factor of $17.$
